S1.title: Multiscale dynamics of charging and plating in graphite electrodes coupling operando microscopy and phase-field modelling
S1.scope: Graphite: particle geometry, pore bottlenecks, heterogeneous reaction and plating; operando measurements plus modelling.

S2.title: Quantifying microstructural dynamics and electrochemical activity of graphite and silicon-graphite lithium ion battery anodes
S2.scope: Graphite/Si-graphite: geometry, anisotropic transport and evolving porosity/strain, measured by tomography.

S3.title: Unravelling electro-chemo-mechanical processes in graphite/silicon composites for designing nanoporous and microstructured battery electrodes
S3.scope: Si-graphite: internal porous architecture, graphite enclosure, CBD evolution, strain and current redistribution. Conditional relevance until Si is confirmed.

S4.title: The electrode tortuosity factor: why the conventional tortuosity factor is not well suited for quantifying transport in porous Li-ion battery electrodes and what to use instead
S4.scope: Transport modelling: geometric paths alone do not establish transport tortuosity; dead-end pores can remain electrochemically useful.

S5.title: Investigation of film solidification and binder migration during drying of Li-Ion battery anodes
S5.scope: Manufacturing: drying, binder redistribution and adhesion. Morphology alone cannot identify binder.

S6.title: New method for binder and carbon black detection at nanometer scale in carbon electrodes for lithium ion batteries
S6.scope: Graphite/PVDF/carbon black: calibrated energy-selective BSE is needed to distinguish overlapping carbonaceous domains; normal BSE/InLens is insufficient by itself.

S7.title: Effect of electrode manufacturing defects on electrochemical performance of lithium-ion batteries: Cognizance of the battery failure sources
S7.scope: Manufacturing defects intentionally introduced in NMC cathodes. Transfer evidence for anode feature screening, not validated anode severity thresholds.

S8.title: Investigation of the Influence of Electrode Surface Structures on Wettability after Electrolyte Filling Based on Experiments and a Lattice Boltzmann Simulation
S8.scope: Surface geometry, pore apertures, filling and gas entrapment; wetting needs fluid/surface information beyond dry SEM.

S9.title: Interfacially Induced Cascading Failure in Graphite-Silicon Composite Anodes
S9.scope: Cycled Si-graphite: interparticle cracking and electronic isolation. Explains possible future failure, not existing cycling damage in fresh samples.

S10.title: Deep learning-based segmentation of lithium-ion battery microstructures enhanced by artificially generated electrodes
S10.scope: Multiphase graphite-silicon imaging/segmentation; method and phase-identification precedent, using X-ray imaging rather than these SEM exports.

S11.title: Influence of graphite edge crystallographic orientation on the first lithium intercalation in Li-ion battery
S11.scope: Edge crystallography, SEI and exfoliation/co-intercalation response. Crystal-edge identity requires structural characterization, not particle outline.

S12.title: Methods—Kintsugi Imaging of Battery Electrodes: Distinguishing Pores from the Carbon Binder Domain using Pt Deposition
S12.scope: Contrast-engineered electrode SEM distinguishes pore and carbon-binder domain; preparation changes the contrast, so labels do not transfer blindly.

S13.title: Critical electrode properties and drying conditions causing component segregation in graphitic anodes for lithium-ion batteries
S13.scope: Graphite anode processing, component segregation and electrode properties.

S14.title: Lift-Out Specimen Preparation and Multiscale Correlative Investigation of Li-Ion Battery Electrodes Using Focused Ion Beam-Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry Platforms
